briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Swear the World-Root Snare Path: Relic Detour. Enter World-Root Snare Path on Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate while the Gate remains Ruin Gate with active oath memory. Reference deity voice is Odin, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, open the relic detour in the elite-tuned World-Root Snare Path, secure the relic detour, and take the reward without awakening the wrong memory.

missionIntro.speaker: Odin Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The oath hears footsteps before thunder. The World-Root Snare Path will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the treasure or lore pressure of Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: world-root snare paths that remember old betrayals

victory.speaker: Odin Divine Voice
victory.text: The storm has heard the oath and left it standing.

defeat.speaker: Odin Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Thunder-Oath Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents World-Root Snare Path as part of Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame World-Root Snare Path as a treasure or lore node in Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet; storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
